title: Don't Clean Your Room With the World's Biggest Digger
description:
Cleaning advice nobody needed: use a vacuum, not the Bagger 293.

The real machine:
- Bagger 293 is a bucket-wheel excavator built by TAKRAF in 1995 for German open-pit mining.
- It weighs 14,200 tons and holds the Guinness record as the heaviest land vehicle.
- It is 96 meters (315 feet) tall; the Statue of Liberty is 305 feet from the ground to the torch.
- It can move about 240,000 cubic meters of earth a day, roughly four Olympic swimming pools (2,500 m³ each) every hour.

Useless Facts is our series of true facts nobody needed. Be honest: how bad is your room right now?

Sources:
- TAKRAF, Bucket-wheel excavators (Bagger 293: 225 m long, 96 m tall, 240,000 m³ per day): https://takraf.com/product/bucket-wheel-excavators
- Wikipedia, Bagger 293: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bagger_293
- National Park Service, Statue of Liberty statistics (305 ft 1 in ground to torch): https://www.nps.gov/stli/learn/historyculture/statue-statistics.htm
